description: This file defines a controller class for managing comments within the admin section of an OpenCart-based CMS. It handles listing, approving, marking as spam, deleting comments, and updating their ratings. The class interacts with models for comments and articles, and renders views for the comment list.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing comments in the admin interface of the CMS. Handles listing, approving, marking as spam, deleting comments, and updating ratings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the comment management view with header, footer, and necessary scripts.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of comments in response to AJAX or direct requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered comments, prepares data, and renders the comment list view.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves selected comments, sets their status to approved, and updates commenters.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Marks selected comments as spam, removes them, and updates customer history.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected comments from the database.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Updates ratings for comments in batches and handles pagination.
